title: Appeals Court Weighs Pentagon’s Media Restrictions
summary: A three-judge panel considered the requirement that journalists be accompanied by an escort when visiting the Pentagon. The New York Times sued to block the restriction.

title: Dr. Deborah Birx on U.S. loss of measles elimination status
summary: It's a step backwards in the U.S. medical community. Twenty-six years after the measles was first eradicated across the country, the U.S. has lost elimination status. Dr. Deborah Birx, the former White House COVID response coordinator during the first Trump administration, joins "The Takeout" to discuss.
